user.title: Select your utility
user.description: Pick your utility company. If it is not listed, choose "Andere / Other" and enter the portal address yourself.

manual.title: Portal address
manual.description: For {example_name} the portal URL is {example_url}. The part before /powercommerce is the host ({example_host}), the part after it is the tenant ({example_tenant}). Enter the same two parts of your utility's portal URL.

credentials.title: Portal login
credentials.description: Your login for {host}. The credentials are verified by an actual login.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, or the portal requires a two-factor code.
error.no_meter: The login worked, but the account has no electricity meter.

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: The current reading is fetched from a small JSON endpoint; the reading history is a full page and only feeds the statistics backfill.
